always_prepared.name: Always Prepared
always_prepared.summary: Retrieve a useful item, information, or small weapon as a quick action.

archer.name: Archer
archer.summary: Free Re-roll when using, repairing, evaluating, or handling a bow.

artist.name: Artist
artist.summary: Choose an art form; gain a Free Re-roll for rolls about it.

bodybuilder.name: Bodybuilder
bodybuilder.summary: Free Re-roll when lifting, carrying, or breaking something.

car_jump.name: Car Jump
car_jump.summary: While driving, leap a land or water ride over an obstacle or gain +2 Chase Speed; lose 1 Armor on landing.

cash_flow.name: Cash Flow
cash_flow.summary: Start with 3 Cash and gain 1 Cash each Session unless unavailable.

combo.name: Combo
combo.summary: After hitting an Enemy, spend 1 Adrenaline to deal 1 additional Grit.

counter.name: Counter
counter.summary: React with Brawn+Fight instead of the requested Skill and ignore situational -1s.

crazy_stunt.name: Crazy Stunt
crazy_stunt.summary: Destroy your ride during a chase for a coin-flip chance to fill 1 or 5 Need boxes.

detective.name: Detective
detective.summary: Free Re-roll when looking for clues, following trails, or searching a room.

full_throttle.name: Full Throttle!
full_throttle.summary: Ignore Nervous and Top Speed penalties while driving; gain 1 Adrenaline once per chase at Top Speed.

flying_kick.name: Flying Kick
flying_kick.summary: Attack at Close or Medium Range with +1; Close attacks can be bare-handed without spending Adrenaline.

get_down.name: Get Down!
get_down.summary: You and another Hero hide, dodge bullets, or avoid a vehicle without rolling.

gunslinger.name: Gunslinger
gunslinger.summary: Free Re-roll when using, repairing, evaluating, or handling a pistol or revolver.

hacker.name: Hacker
hacker.summary: Free Re-roll for computer, hacking, and IT-security rolls.

hard_to_kill.name: Hard to Kill
hard_to_kill.summary: When filling your Bad Box, gain 1 Adrenaline and +1 to your next roll.

head_on_a_swivel.name: Head on a Swivel
head_on_a_swivel.summary: Free Re-roll when preempting danger or ambushes, or locating lurking enemies.

heartbreaker.name: Heartbreaker
heartbreaker.summary: Free Re-roll when seducing or making a good impression.

high_culture.name: High Culture
high_culture.summary: Free Re-roll to recall general culture, literature, history, or geography.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.summary: Free Re-roll to follow or hunt animals, navigate wilds, or hide in the wild.

intimidation.name: Intimidation
intimidation.summary: Free Re-roll when intimidating or interrogating someone.

intuition.name: Intuition
intuition.summary: Ask the Director for a clue or suggestion, or find an Enemy Weak Spot.

ill_make_a_phone_call.name: I'll Make a Phone Call
ill_make_a_phone_call.summary: Call a contact for information, a favor, a ride, or up to 3 Cash for the next Time-Out.

knife_thrower.name: Knife Thrower
knife_thrower.summary: Gain +1 when using a throwing weapon.

lie_to_me.name: Lie to Me
lie_to_me.summary: Free Re-roll to understand intentions or spot lies.

lockpick.name: Lockpick
lockpick.summary: Free Re-roll when picking a lock, door, or closed container.

marksman.name: Marksman
marksman.summary: Free Re-roll when using, repairing, evaluating, or handling a rifle, shotgun, sub-machine, or machine gun.

martial_arts.name: Martial Arts
martial_arts.summary: Free Re-roll for Action and Reaction Rolls when fighting unarmed.

master_of_disguise.name: Master of Disguise
master_of_disguise.summary: Free Re-roll to disguise yourself, go unnoticed, or assume another identity.

mastermind.name: Mastermind
mastermind.summary: Repeat one roll of any kind and ignore situational -1s.

mechanic.name: Mechanic
mechanic.summary: Free Re-roll when building or repairing Rides and other gear.

military_background.name: Military Background
military_background.summary: Free Re-roll for military knowledge, strategy coordination, or recalling training.

outsmart.name: Outsmart
outsmart.summary: Make any Action or Reaction Roll using Know instead of its required Skill.

parkour.name: Parkour
parkour.summary: Free Re-roll when jumping, performing acrobatics, or breaking a fall.

pep_talk.name: Pep Talk
pep_talk.summary: Free Re-roll when inspiring or coordinating others.

physician.name: Physician
physician.summary: Free Re-roll to diagnose, operate, or remove physical Conditions.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.summary: Free Re-roll when stealing something from somebody.

proven_driver.name: Proven Driver
proven_driver.summary: Choose a ride type; gain a Free Re-roll when driving, repairing, or evaluating it.

punch_reload.name: Punch Reload
punch_reload.summary: Once per combat after failing a Reaction Roll, stand up and immediately gain 1 Adrenaline.

reporter.name: Reporter
reporter.summary: Free Re-roll when interviewing people, gaining information, or finding contacts.

scientist.name: Scientist
scientist.summary: Choose a STEM discipline; gain a Free Re-roll for rolls concerning it.

selfless.name: Selfless
selfless.summary: Free Re-roll when defending or saving others, or acting selflessly.

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.summary: Free Re-roll when hiding, sneaking, or tailing someone.

silver_tongue.name: Silver Tongue
silver_tongue.summary: Free Re-roll to lie, persuade, compromise, or bargain.

spinout.name: Spinout
spinout.summary: During a chase, skip the driving ride's Reaction Turn and flip a coin for -1 or +1 Speed.

thats_all.name: That's All?
thats_all.summary: Free Re-roll to show courage, withstand pain, or resist threats and interrogations.

too_young_to_die.name: Too Young to Die
too_young_to_die.summary: When filling the Bad Box, suffer no Condition; available only to Young Heroes.
